classPrimeCountStream{conststd::vector<std::int64_t>&primes;std::vector<std::int64_t>next;std::vector<unsignedchar>sieve;std::int64_tmaximum,low,count;std::size_toffset=0,length=0;voidfill(){low+=2*static_cast<std::int64_t>(length);length=static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::int64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(sieve.size()),(maximum-low)/2+1));std::fill(sieve.begin(),sieve.begin()+length,1);conststd::int64_thigh=low+2*(static_cast<std::int64_t>(length)-1);for(std::size_ti=2;i<next.size();++i){conststd::int64_tp=primes[i];if(p>high/p)break;std::int64_tj=(next[i]-low)/2;for(;j<static_cast<std::int64_t>(length);j+=p)sieve[j]=0;next[i]=low+2*j;}offset=0;}public:PrimeCountStream(std::int64_tstart,std::int64_tfinish,std::int64_tpiStart,constPhiTables&tables):primes(tables.primes()),next(static_cast<std::size_t>(tables.pi()[IntegerSqrt(finish)])+1),sieve(static_cast<std::size_t>(std::max<std::int64_t>(32768,IntegerSqrt(finish)))),maximum(finish),low(start+1),count(piStart){if(low%2==0)++low;for(std::size_ti=2;i<next.size();++i){conststd::int64_tp=primes[i];std::int64_tfirst=std::max(p*p,low+(p-low%p)%p);if(first%2==0)first+=p;next[i]=first;}}std::int64_tcountTo(std::int64_ttarget){while(low+2*static_cast<std::int64_t>(offset)<=target){if(offset==length)fill();conststd::size_tstop=static_cast<std::size_t>(std::min<std::int64_t>(static_cast<std::int64_t>(length),(target-low)/2+1));count=std::accumulate(sieve.begin()+offset,sieve.begin()+stop,count);offset=stop;}returncount;}}
